examples.arabic: التقى الجار احمد بالجار سامي صباحا
examples.english: Neighbor Ahmed met neighbor Sami in the morning.
examples.transliteration: Altaqa al-jaar Ahmad bil-jaar Saami sabaahan.
examples.storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Strange Friend

examples.arabic: يجب ان نذهب الى السوق او نسال الجار
examples.english: We must go to the market or ask the neighbor.
examples.transliteration: Yajibu an nadhhab ila as-suq aw nas'al al-jar.

examples.arabic: ساله الجار القديم ما اسمك من فضلك انا لا اتذكر
examples.english: The old neighbor asked him 'What's your name please I don't remember'
examples.transliteration: Sa'alahu al-jaru al-qadim ma ismuka min fadlik ana la atadhakkar
examples.storyTitle: New Neighbors and a Weak Memory
